summary:
**LunaSight – Lunar Landing Site Navigator**

LunaSight is an interactive lunar exploration application designed to help mission planners identify, explore, and compare potential landing sites on the Moon. It addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by bringing key landing-site considerations into one accessible platform, including lunar surface location, solar visibility, Earth visibility for communication, and mission time planning.

The application features an interactive lunar polar map where users can select locations, explore site information, and save custom sites for later analysis. It also provides tools for comparing candidate sites and examining how lighting and communication visibility may change over time.

LunaSight aims to make complex lunar mission-planning concepts easier to explore and understand, helping users consider the relationship between landing location, sunlight availability, and communication opportunities. Its long-term vision is to integrate more complete scientific datasets and validated terrain and ephemeris models, supporting increasingly reliable analysis for future lunar missions.
details:
LunaSight – Lunar Landing Site Navigator

LunaSight is an interactive lunar landing-site exploration and mission-planning application developed to help users understand the factors involved in selecting suitable landing locations on the Moon.

The application provides an interactive lunar polar map where users can explore the lunar surface, select potential landing locations, view site information, and save custom sites for further analysis. It also brings together tools for exploring solar visibility, Earth visibility for communication planning, mission time planning, and comparison of candidate landing sites.

Our goal is to make complex lunar mission-planning considerations easier to visualize and understand through an accessible, interactive interface. By connecting location selection with lighting, communication visibility, and time-based planning, LunaSight helps users examine how different factors may influence a potential lunar mission.

We developed the application using Flutter and Dart, targeting Android. The development environment included the Flutter SDK, Dart, Android development tools, and supporting packages such as path_provider, http, crypto, and meta.

A major creative aspect of LunaSight is its combination of an interactive lunar map with multiple mission-planning perspectives in one application. Instead of treating a landing location as just a coordinate, users can explore it as part of a wider mission-planning context.

Our team considered usability, lunar coordinates, polar-region exploration, lighting conditions, communication opportunities, time-dependent analysis, data reliability, and the need to distinguish validated scientific calculations from preliminary or illustrative results.

The intended impact is to make lunar exploration concepts more accessible to students, educators, space enthusiasts, and early-stage mission planners. Future development will focus on integrating more complete and validated ephemeris and lunar terrain datasets to improve the scientific depth and reliability of the analysis.
